summary: Keep the source task as a fresh exact deferral. Direct regulatory, investor and seller records support Astoria Power Partners Holding, LLC as the probable one-platform survivor for the APP I and APP II interests, correct Munich Re/MEAG's entry date to 2020-06-18, and report MR Gotham LP at 20.0000% of APPH at 2025-12-31. The same records do not prove the final post-closing APG and CalSTRS allocations, cutoff-current continuity and exact interests for APG, CalSTRS, Clal, Harbert, GPP/CalPERS and other institutional investors, or reciprocal legal identity between the requested Astoria Energy Partners label and APPH. Financing and plant-operation evidence cannot fill that ownership gap.
resolvedFormerBlockers: The direct NYPSC transaction record and ENGIE closing release establish a single APPH platform above 100% of APP I and approximately 55% of APP II, preserving the two-plant platform boundary without separately counting plant or project SPVs.
Munich Re's direct half-year report verifies 2020-06-18 as the MR Gotham transaction completion date, correcting the prior 2019 or July 2020 ambiguity.
Munich Re's direct 2025 annual report reports MR Gotham LP at 20.0000% of APPH at 2025-12-31.

The filed 2020 materials identify historical purchaser-member and look-through structures for Gotham, MR Gotham and Clal and distinguish the GPP/CalPERS project-II interests from APPH-level ownership.
CalSTRS' direct holdings page preserves Golden Inferno as a disclosed June 2025 holding, while confirming that no percentage or APPH look-through may be inferred from the listing.
The direct ENGIE, NYPSC and S&P materials preserve seller, power-purchaser, operating and financing roles without converting those roles into current equity.

identityResolution.boundary: Count the manager-level APPH platform once. Astoria Project Partners LLC, Astoria Project Partners II LLC, Astoria Energy LLC, Astoria Energy II LLC, individual plants, turbines, operators, NYPA contract rights, lenders and acquisition SPVs remain subordinate or separate boundaries rather than additional PortCos.

operatingResolution.appI: Astoria Project Partners LLC wholly owns Astoria Energy LLC; the plant sells output on a merchant basis.
operatingResolution.appII: Astoria Project Partners II LLC wholly owns Astoria Energy II LLC; the plant sells output to NYPA under a long-term power purchase agreement.
operatingResolution.roleRule: Power purchaser, seller, project operator, lender, rating agency, debt authorization and refinancing roles are not treated as equity ownership or proof of ownership continuity.

transactionResolution.finding: APPH acquired 100% of APP I and approximately 55% of APP II in the 2020 transaction. A 2025 Astoria Energy LLC refinancing and 2026 debt authorization were found, but neither establishes an equity transfer or cutoff-current cap table. No signed pending ownership transaction was verified.
